content.comment_body: Hello, Is it possible to monitor logic live within blocks on the built-in display of [product_name]? Similar to what is available in LAD logic environments?

Hello, Currently, you can only monitor the status of inputs and outputs (both digital and analog) on the display. However, you can show parameter values of blocks from your program by configuring them within a Text message, allowing you to view certain logic results. This works for analog blocks, math operations, and timers/counters. When setting up a Text block, you'll see which blocks can be included for display.

analysis.insight_summary: A user asks if real-time logic monitoring is possible on the built-in display of [product_name], similar to LAD logic view. The response indicates that only input and output statuses are shown, but parameters can be viewed through Text messages. This reveals that direct logic monitoring is not available in the device interface.
analysis.user_expectations: The user hopes to monitor program logic live on the [product_name] device display, similar to what is possible in other LAD logic systems.
